category_title: Middle school students with severe reading disabilities who disengage from traditional tasks
scenario_title: Independent iPad work and off-task behavior
minimal_context: The student is using an iPad to complete an assigned task that will be shared on a large screen with the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have a tight timeline today. Please use your iPad to complete the assigned task so we can share it on the large screen with the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the iPad) Yeah, I know we have to share it on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How is your progress coming along?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Opens the web browser) I'm just checking something online real quick.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Make sure you keep working on the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the assignment and continues searching the Internet for items off-task, scrolling through unrelated websites)
